name: Ferienhaus Felkel
beschreibung:
Wonderfully located in Pertisau on the shores of Tyrol's largest lake, Ferienhaus Felkel welcomes guests with a warm ambiance and comfortable living quarters. The apartments provide a peaceful retreat for outdoor holidays.

The lakeside promenade, boat landing, and entrances to the majestic Karwendel Nature Park valleys are all just a short walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Felkel in Pertisau offers cosy holiday apartments close to the pristine shores of Lake Achensee.
